title: Predicting Clinical Events Based on Raw Text: From Bag-of-Words to Attention-Based Transformers.
summary: The study compared bag-of-words, recurrent neural networks and attention/transformer language models on electronic-record narratives to predict readmission and mortality-related events in one health-system cohort. The retrospective evaluation does not establish benefit from using the predictions in care.
